boundary_references.expectation: Resolve packaged artifact and OS path before connecting launcher to backend entry; preserve wsPort argument origin
boundary_references.negative: Unrelated executable with the same basename must remain separate
boundary_references.runtime: Record parent/child process identities, arguments, backend readiness and successful request

boundary_references.expectation: Terminate/wait/kill refer to the owned process handle, with timeout fallback
boundary_references.negative: Two server instances must not release each other's process
boundary_references.runtime: Observe normal termination and forced-kill fallback with no retained child

boundary_references.expectation: Follow selected server host/port through backend_ws_uri and startup configuration
boundary_references.negative: Same path or port in another service/deployment is not a unique target
boundary_references.runtime: Correlate client socket, proxy-selected server and accepting backend instance

boundary_references.expectation: Application, runner, site and route handler belong to one configured listener
boundary_references.negative: Another Application with an identical route must not share handlers
boundary_references.runtime: Verify listener address and HTTP/WebSocket dispatch under the selected proxy configuration

boundary_references.expectation: Preserve client-to-backend payload forwarding and text/binary branch conditions
boundary_references.negative: Reverse-direction forwarding and two simultaneous pairs must retain distinct identities
boundary_references.runtime: Use distinguishable payloads in both directions and assert pair isolation

boundary_references.expectation: Track assignment and adoption of message callbacks on the same socket instance
boundary_references.negative: A callback registered on a different socket is not executed by this receive event
boundary_references.runtime: Record socket/request identity and actual callback/response adoption

boundary_references.expectation: Expose outgoing and incoming window endpoints with host channel, origin and runtime-mode conditions; establish actual pairing only from its scope
boundary_references.negative: Same message name in another window/origin is not an unconditional connection
boundary_references.runtime: Exercise embedded host and native WebSocket modes with window/channel identity

boundary_references.expectation: Resolve worker URL relative to the creator and build entry, then connect message schemas
boundary_references.negative: A sibling worker with the same message type is not this worker's target
boundary_references.runtime: Observe creation, request/result identity, replacement and terminate/cleanup

boundary_references.expectation: Connect dispatch branch, generation identity and output producer within the selected worker
boundary_references.negative: A stale generation's result must not become current state
boundary_references.runtime: Assert normal, late-result, cancellation/replacement and resource-release behavior

boundary_references.expectation: Relate WebView resource URL and selected port to packaged frontend/backend artifacts
boundary_references.negative: Development HTTP URL and release resource URL keep distinct conditions
boundary_references.runtime: Verify actual frontend load and a backend request from the selected OS/build mode

boundary_references.expectation: Resolve key constant, owning handler map and constructed handler type before connecting dispatch
boundary_references.negative: Same key in a different registry does not share targets
boundary_references.runtime: Record selected registry/handler and a distinguishable response

boundary_references.expectation: Represent registration/callback and matching removal with emitter and callback identity
boundary_references.negative: Same event on another emitter or another callback cannot remove this subscription
boundary_references.runtime: Assert one delivery before removal and no delivery after teardown

boundary_references.expectation: Expose read/write resource expressions; connect only when path value and lifecycle establish the same artifact
boundary_references.negative: Equal basename under different directories does not identify a shared resource
boundary_references.runtime: Use an isolated known input/output artifact, check content and cleanup independently

boundary_references.expectation: Connect database instance/path, device-selected table and creation/insert/query operations
boundary_references.negative: Same table name in another database or device does not merge ownership
boundary_references.runtime: Import a public fixture and assert schema, row values and device/database isolation

boundary_references.expectation: Represent the TS host plugin and Python server-extension registrations, package/configuration and actual API boundaries; membership alone is not a direct call
boundary_references.negative: Same plugin id in an inactive/other host configuration does not imply activation
boundary_references.runtime: Load the extension in JupyterLab and verify its actual registered handler and frontend interaction

boundary_references.expectation: Resolve base_url, route list and handler type within one web_app
